name: SwissAssociation
description: Document model for incorporating a Swiss Non-profit Association (Verein) under Art. 60-79 ZGB. Tracks the full 3-phase lifecycle: Pre-Incorporation, Founding Meeting, and Multisig Setup.

global.schema:
enum PrimaryLanguage {
  EN
  DE
}

enum MemberType {
  NATURAL_PERSON
  LEGAL_ENTITY
}

enum PhaseStatus {
  LOCKED
  IN_PROGRESS
  AWAITING_SIGNATURES
  COMPLETE
}

enum Stage2DocumentType {
  AOA
  FOUNDING_MINUTES
  MPA
  REG_GA
}

type AssociationMember {
  id: OID!
  type: MemberType!
  name: String!
  nationalityOrCountry: String!
  residenceOrCity: String!
  representative: String
}

type MultisigConfig {
  platform: String
  address: String
  keysTotal: Int
  decisionQuorum: Int
  privateChannel: String
  availabilityThreshold: String
  internalPolicyLink: String
  multisigDate: Date
  emergencyProcedures: String
}

type PhaseRecord {
  id: OID!
  phaseNumber: Int!
  name: String!
  status: PhaseStatus!
  documentsGenerated: Boolean!
  documentsSigned: Boolean!
  completedDate: Date
}

type GeneratedStage2Document {
  markdown: String
  isSigned: Boolean
  signedAt: DateTime
  isLocked: Boolean
}

type SwissAssociationState {
  nameEn: String
  nameDe: String
  seatCity: String
  seatCanton: String
  registeredAddress: String
  foundingDate: Date
  fiscalYearEnd: String
  membershipFee: String
  primaryLanguage: PrimaryLanguage
  purposeEn: String
  purposeDe: String
  members: [AssociationMember!]!
  boardMembers: [AssociationMember!]
  isPersonalunion: Boolean
  chairName: String
  chairRole: String
  secretaryName: String
  secretaryRole: String
  multisig: MultisigConfig
  stage2Started: Boolean
  aoaDocument: GeneratedStage2Document
  foundingMinutesDocument: GeneratedStage2Document
  mpaDocument: GeneratedStage2Document
  regGaDocument: GeneratedStage2Document
  incorporationCompletedAt: DateTime
  currentPhase: Int
  phases: [PhaseRecord!]!
  languageClauseNeedsUpdate: Boolean
  belowRecommendedMemberCount: Boolean
  registeredAddressConfirmed: Boolean
  customNotes: [String!]!
}
global.initialValue: {"nameEn": null, "nameDe": null, "seatCity": "Zug", "seatCanton": "Canton Zug", "registeredAddress": null, "foundingDate": null, "fiscalYearEnd": "31 December", "membershipFee": "none", "primaryLanguage": "EN", "purposeEn": null, "purposeDe": null, "members": [], "boardMembers": null, "isPersonalunion": null, "chairName": null, "chairRole": null, "secretaryName": null, "secretaryRole": null, "multisig": null, "stage2Started": null, "aoaDocument": null, "foundingMinutesDocument": null, "mpaDocument": null, "regGaDocument": null, "incorporationCompletedAt": null, "currentPhase": 1, "phases": [{"id": "phase-1", "phaseNumber": 1, "name": "Pre-Incorporation", "status": "IN_PROGRESS", "documentsGenerated": false, "documentsSigned": false, "completedDate": null}, {"id": "phase-2", "phaseNumber": 2, "name": "Founding Meeting", "status": "LOCKED", "documentsGenerated": false, "documentsSigned": false, "completedDate": null}, {"id": "phase-3", "phaseNumber": 3, "name": "Multisig Setup", "status": "LOCKED", "documentsGenerated": false, "documentsSigned": false, "completedDate": null}], "languageClauseNeedsUpdate": true, "belowRecommendedMemberCount": null, "registeredAddressConfirmed": null, "customNotes": []}

modules.name: association
modules.description: Operations for managing association identity, seat, purpose and fiscal details

operations.name: SET_ASSOCIATION_NAME
operations.description: Sets the association name in English and optionally German
operations.template: Sets the association name in English and optionally German
operations.reducer:
state.nameEn = action.input.nameEn;
if (action.input.nameDe) state.nameDe = action.input.nameDe;

operations.name: SET_ASSOCIATION_SEAT
operations.description: Sets the registered seat and address of the association
operations.template: Sets the registered seat and address of the association

operations.name: SET_FOUNDING_DATE
operations.description: Sets the founding date of the association
operations.template: Sets the founding date of the association
operations.reducer: state.foundingDate = action.input.foundingDate;

operations.name: SET_FISCAL_DETAILS
operations.description: Sets fiscal year end, membership fee, and primary language
operations.template: Sets fiscal year end, membership fee, and primary language

operations.name: SET_PURPOSE
operations.description: Sets the association purpose in English and optionally German
operations.template: Sets the association purpose in English and optionally German
operations.reducer:
state.purposeEn = action.input.purposeEn;
if (action.input.purposeDe) state.purposeDe = action.input.purposeDe;

operations.name: ADD_MEMBER
operations.description: Adds a founding member to the association
operations.schema:
input AddMemberInput {
  id: OID!
  type: MemberType!
  name: String!
  nationalityOrCountry: String!
  residenceOrCity: String!
  representative: String
}
operations.template: Adds a founding member to the association

operations.name: UPDATE_MEMBER
operations.description: Updates an existing founding member
operations.schema:
input UpdateMemberInput {
  id: OID!
  type: MemberType
  name: String
  nationalityOrCountry: String
  residenceOrCity: String
  representative: String
}
operations.template: Updates an existing founding member

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: The specified member was not found

operations.name: REMOVE_MEMBER
operations.description: Removes a founding member
operations.template: Removes a founding member

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: The specified member was not found

operations.template: Sets chair and secretary names and roles for the founding meeting

operations.name: SET_MULTISIG_CONFIG
operations.description: Sets the full multisig wallet configuration
operations.schema:
input SetMultisigConfigInput {
  platform: String!
  address: String!
  keysTotal: Int!
  decisionQuorum: Int!
  privateChannel: String
  availabilityThreshold: String
  internalPolicyLink: String
  multisigDate: Date
  emergencyProcedures: String
}
operations.template: Sets the full multisig wallet configuration
operations.reducer:
state.multisig = {
  platform: action.input.platform,
  address: action.input.address,
  keysTotal: action.input.keysTotal,
  decisionQuorum: action.input.decisionQuorum,
  privateChannel: action.input.privateChannel || null,
  availabilityThreshold: action.input.availabilityThreshold || null,
  internalPolicyLink: action.input.internalPolicyLink || null,
  multisigDate: action.input.multisigDate || null,
  emergencyProcedures: action.input.emergencyProcedures || null,
};

operations.name: START_STAGE_2

operations.template: Sets the markdown content for a stage 2 document

operations.name: MARK_STAGE2_DOCUMENT_SIGNED

operations.template: Marks a stage 2 document as signed and locks it
